title: nntrainer CentroidKNN chooses an unobserved class over an exact centroid match
author: Xamit Kadirbekov
summary: A positive zero-sample sentinel outranks every finite negative distance. Native component and public model execution verify wrong class decisions, a one-line candidate and restoration.
limits: CPU FP32 NCHW batch1; synthetic finite modest features; at least one observed class. No real-image benchmark, device, customer, all-unseen policy, full-suite or released-binary validation.
measured_chain: Positive score for an unobserved class -> it outranks an exact-match centroid -> two synthetic public-model queries get the wrong class; candidate fixes both, restoration reproduces both; three fully trained controls unchanged.
